# GotCOS

> Open-source AI chief of staff. The harness, memory, and context layer you own around rented AI models. Created by Miles Ukaoma.

## Field guides

- [What is an AI harness?](https://www.gotcos.com/harness/): the model is rented, the harness is yours — memory, files, rules, and skills around any frontier model
- [The AI Adoption Index](https://www.gotcos.com/ai-adoption/): how many people actually use AI — survey-anchored, source-tiered, updated July 2026
- [Context engineering vs prompt engineering](https://www.gotcos.com/context-engineering-vs-prompt-engineering/): the real shift — engineering the system around the model, not the sentence
- [Embodied intelligence](https://www.gotcos.com/embodied-intelligence/): a cited visual history of intelligence moving from screens to wearables, autonomous roads, and useful robots
- [AI chief of staff vs human chief of staff](https://www.gotcos.com/ai-chief-of-staff-vs-human-chief-of-staff/): what changes when the briefing layer is software
- [COS Glasses docs](https://www.gotcos.com/docs/): user guide for the G2 smart-glasses client
- [COS Control for Mac](https://www.gotcos.com/control/): the Mac companion that runs the open-source server and opens an Activity window with seven views: messages, speakers, meetings, memories, threads, agent sessions, and Work — existing tasks grouped by domain with confirmed meeting links and recorded handoffs
- [COS Blueprint](https://www.gotcos.com/blueprint/): a 12-question, role-based build plan for your AI chief of staff
- [Glasses Challenge](https://www.gotcos.com/challenge/): win a pair of Even G2 glasses by showing what you would do with your chief of staff on the lens, not a raffle

## Open data

- [adoption-surveys.csv](https://www.gotcos.com/ai-adoption/data/adoption-surveys.csv): generative-AI adoption by survey wave — Pew, Reuters Institute, Google-Ipsos, Microsoft WTI (percent, 2023-2026)
- [provider-milestones.csv](https://www.gotcos.com/ai-adoption/data/provider-milestones.csv): dated user and revenue milestones per AI provider, with trust tier — not additive across providers
- [us-state-btos.csv](https://www.gotcos.com/ai-adoption/data/us-state-btos.csv): share of US businesses using AI by state — Census Bureau BTOS
- [eu-enterprise-ai.csv](https://www.gotcos.com/ai-adoption/data/eu-enterprise-ai.csv): share of EU enterprises using AI by country — Eurostat isoc_eb_ai

- [btos-state-series.csv](https://www.gotcos.com/ai-adoption/data/btos-state-series.csv): biweekly share of US businesses using AI, Sep 2023 - Jun 2026, national + every state (Census BTOS)
- [eurostat-country-series.csv](https://www.gotcos.com/ai-adoption/data/eurostat-country-series.csv): annual share of enterprises using AI, 2021-2025, 35 European geographies (Eurostat)

Compilation CC BY 4.0 (cite "GotCOS AI Adoption Index"); underlying figures belong to their publishers. Compiled 2026-07-15.

## COS Glasses 635, current companion pack

COS Glasses 6.10.635 is the current companion pack. The versioned package and canonical alias are published in the Glasses Hub repository; it installs by sideload and needs Even App 2.2.10 or newer. The last build observed Public on Even Hub is 6.10.629; 635 has not been confirmed Public in the marketplace. 6.10.587 was submitted for marketplace review on October 4, 2026. Published server is 6.71.12. Public COS Control is 0.5.287, Developer ID signed and Apple notarized. Start at https://www.gotcos.com/control/: download, move to Applications, open, connect a signed-in AI provider, Get started, Open Sessions. Core server setup bundles Node/npm and requires no Homebrew/npm/npx installation. Local voice setup downloads verified, signed and notarized Whisper tools inside Control without Homebrew. Optional media features have separate dependencies. Since Control 0.5.278 the Mac shows a Live now meeting transcript, with Jump to live and Copy transcript; live text and speaker matches are preliminary, and saving opens the saved record. Control 0.5.282 with server 6.70.0 adds Live COS Ask beside the live transcript: presets and typed questions answered from the current meeting first, with COS memory and earlier meetings for typed questions; question and answer history saved per meeting; files and screenshots shared in the meeting, with their text read on the Mac; the Meeting assistant model under the Ask box and in Settings (Haiku by default then; since Control 0.5.287 and server 6.71.12 fresh settings default to Sonnet and a saved choice is kept); Copy full context; and sources that open where they came from. Public web search normally uses typed public-topic words. Server 6.71.5 also supports explicit consent to select public keywords from recent transcript passages for fact-checks and cost comparisons; private details are withheld. Companion 628 added the choice, and 629 includes it. The menu bar and Dock show when a meeting records. Since Control 0.5.285 with server 6.71.0 or newer, Live COS Ask answers read as labeled rows, So what first, and Catch me up reads the whole meeting. Control 0.5.287 with server 6.71.12 adds Fact check for a recent public claim under the public-topic setting, follow-ups on a saved meeting, and reviewing an answer as a Work follow-up before it becomes a task.

[HUD and signal guide](https://www.gotcos.com/docs/#hud-states): Messages uses ◈ Msg; Sessions uses ↔ Sess and its native Claude, Codex or Cursor identity. Continue uses that session's settings, independent of Messages. A model name is shown only when the session reports it. Messages, Sessions and live Meetings use up for history and down toward live. Home is last in footer actions and first in default COS side shortcuts, beneath Display off. Returning Home leaves recording and jobs active. Known battery is in navigation; live footers keep elapsed time, cancellation and history + Ask.

Working animates the connected COS nodes; explicit completion fills a circle. Separated dots indicate lost contact, pause bars waiting, a speech bubble a question and a hollow shield an approval request. Transient display delays pause and retry decoration; text has priority. Website signal frames are generated from 587 source, with fictional teaching content and illustrative timing.

[Phone meeting and voice review](https://www.gotcos.com/docs/#phone-review): Views, Review meetings on phone, meeting, Review voices. The phone stays monochrome. Read formatted notes, play retained timestamped samples, search saved voice profiles, explicitly choose an existing profile or a new person, and confirm the change. Saved names only enroll reusable voice samples when eligible evidence exists. Pending corrections are not automatically applied on reconnect.

[Offline boundaries](https://www.gotcos.com/docs/#offline-field): Sessions says Saved on phone only after acknowledged exact readback. Full queues retain existing turns and preserve the new draft. Older instructions become Needs review; held turns prevent bypass. Unreadable storage says Unavailable. Build 587 clears the queued placeholder when the Mac confirms delivery through normal polling; delivery is not model completion. Missing receipts remain pending. Broader Messages/task retention, standalone phone voice recording and durable unsynced audio across app relaunches remain upcoming or device-unqualified.

Final dictation cleanup defaults to Haiku, with Sonnet and GPT-5.6 Luna Fast through Cursor CLI as choices (glasses 6.10.616 and server 6.66.0). Sonnet and Luna first arrived in glasses 6.10.573 with server 6.61.5. Failed cleanup preserves transcription.

Server 6.61.4 fixes canonical merged G2 review lookup and adds revision-guarded task-name/finish-line writes. Since Control 0.5.265, the Mac app includes the responsive branded task editor and cache/resize hardening. Work 579 is a separate unpublished candidate and is not part of 587.

The current COS Glasses companion pack in Glasses Hub is 6.10.635, a sideload that needs Even App 2.2.10 or newer; on Even App 2.2.9, 607 is the newest build that installs. Since 625, Meeting Ask shows the live meeting first on Views, has Ask and Transcript tabs with a composer docked at the bottom, and reads every answer as labeled rows, So what first, on the phone and the lens. 626 asks about an ended meeting and adds PDF or text files from the phone (server 6.71.4), 631 saves a reviewed answer as a Work follow-up and searches memory by keyword (server 6.71.11), and 635 adds Fact check for a recent public claim (server 6.71.12; older servers hide it). This builds on Meeting Ask on the phone and the lens (623) with a model switch in the Ask chat (624): presets, typed questions on the phone, history kept by COS on the Mac, and a MEETING ASK reader on the lens that never uses the microphone. MEETING AI still only starts and stops recording. Meeting Ask needs server 6.69.0; public web search needs 6.70.0. 635 also includes Scan code on your Mac pairing (621), a circle that fills before hold to talk records (622) and hold to continue a Cursor session (620). It retains the 599 framed activity reader and 600's server-described Continue behavior, keeps the clock and date on the Messages nav line, shows the battery in the nav only, no longer shows "status unknown" on Home, keeps the working mark moving while a reply streams, names the session on a session page, opens Sessions from a 3-second ring hold on Home, keeps a session page's status row, brings Home weather back after a missed lookup, transcribes dictation on the phone when the Mac is unreachable, also in Mac only, keeps believable preview words when the phone's final text comes back empty, shows a filling ring while the ring is held on Home, and shows a sending arrow while a send goes, with the lens status marks mirrored on the phone. Server 6.62.1 and newer include provider parity, hook-readiness cancellation, safe Cursor continuation, private current-request binding, and precise failed-fork recovery. Server 6.63.0 added background forks, and published server 6.63.1 keeps the last good Home weather across a server restart: a fork started with a client id answers at once, its outcome is read later, and a repeated id never makes a second copy. Older glasses retain Cursor Ask behavior unless they support the Continue note. The 623 and 624 build notes record Meeting Ask tested against a fake COS, not yet on a phone and G2 with a real server. Phone, G2 and Android acceptance of 635 is still pending. Home/pet exact running-count parity is still open. 635 is a sideload, not a marketplace submission. Its package rollback is 6.10.629 from Even Hub with the same server; the Hub repo has no 629 pack, and its 6.10.630 to 6.10.633 packs lack the offline model files and are not for sideloading.

Control 0.5.285 adds evidence-confidence notes, collapsed unavailable-model details and optional Jev setup that no longer blocks the reminder. Server 6.71.5 supplies accepted finalized transcript passages to new saved-meeting answers and preserves historical quotes. Timestamp and progressive-refinement canaries remain disabled. Companion 628 added public-topic consent and a native bridge error-loop fix; both are in 629 and in the current 635 pack.
